title: Vite #10826: Multiline values in .env files cause parse errors

error_signal.message: vite Error: env file parsing fails on multiline values - SyntaxError when .env file contains values with newlines or quotes spanning multiple lines

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Env file parser does not handle multiline values. Lines with continuation characters or quoted strings spanning multiple lines are parsed incorrectly.
ground_truth.fix_description: Update env parser to support multiline values
